note: Hand-checked reference sheet, keyed to cbse10.json chapter ids. NEVER generated by a model: a wrong formula in a reference sheet is worse than no sheet. `when` says when to reach for it, not what it means -- the student can find the meaning in a textbook. `signatures` are Performance error signatures that this formula's line is the fix for, so the sheet can flag marks the student has actually lost.

formulas.name: Ohm's law
formulas.when: Any time two of voltage, current and resistance are given and the third is asked. Write it before substituting.

formulas.name: Resistance of a wire
formulas.when: When the question changes the length or thickness of a wire and asks what happens to R.

formulas.name: Resistors in series
formulas.when: One path, same current through each. Total is bigger than any one.

formulas.name: Resistors in parallel
formulas.when: Branches, same voltage across each. Total is smaller than the smallest -- check your answer against that.

formulas.name: Electric power
formulas.expr: P = V I = I² R = V² / R
formulas.when: Pick the form whose two quantities you already know. All three are the same law.

formulas.name: Joule heating
formulas.when: Heat or energy from a resistor over a time. t must be in seconds.

formulas.name: Energy from power
formulas.when: Electricity bills: kW × h gives kWh, the commercial unit.

formulas.name: Mirror formula
formulas.when: Spherical mirrors only. Fix the sign convention BEFORE substituting: distances against the incoming light are negative.

formulas.name: Magnification (mirror)
formulas.when: Whether the image is bigger, smaller, upright (m positive) or inverted (m negative).

formulas.name: Lens formula
formulas.when: Lenses only. The minus sign is the difference from the mirror formula -- the commonest mix-up on the paper.

formulas.name: Magnification (lens)
formulas.when: Size and orientation of a lens image. No minus sign here, unlike the mirror.

formulas.name: Power of a lens
formulas.when: Whenever dioptres appear. Convert f from cm to m first or the answer is 100× out.

formulas.name: Refractive index
formulas.expr: n = sin i / sin r = c / v
formulas.when: Bending at a boundary, or speed of light in a medium. Use the form that has what you were given.

formulas.name: HCF and LCM
formulas.when: Two numbers only. Given three of the four, find the fourth.

formulas.name: Zeroes of a quadratic
formulas.when: When asked for the sum or product of zeroes, or to build a polynomial from its zeroes.

formulas.name: Polynomial from its zeroes
formulas.when: Building a quadratic from two given zeroes. The minus on the middle term is where marks go.

formulas.name: Quadratic formula
formulas.when: When it will not factorise. Write a, b, c with their signs on one line first.

formulas.name: Discriminant
formulas.when: "Nature of roots": D > 0 two real, D = 0 equal, D < 0 none. Never solve the equation for this.

formulas.name: nth term
formulas.when: A particular term, or which term equals a value. The (n − 1), not n, is the slip.

formulas.name: Sum of n terms
formulas.when: Total of the first n terms. Use the second form when the last term l is known.

formulas.name: Pythagoras
formulas.when: Right angle present and one side missing. State it in words before the numbers -- that line earns a mark.

formulas.name: Basic proportionality
formulas.when: A line parallel to one side of a triangle. Name the theorem -- the name is the method mark.

formulas.name: Similar triangles: sides
formulas.when: After proving similarity (AA, SSS or SAS). Match corresponding vertices before writing ratios.

formulas.name: Distance formula
formulas.when: Length between two points; also to test if a triangle is right-angled or isosceles.

formulas.name: Section formula
formulas.expr: ( (m x₂ + n x₁)/(m+n),  (m y₂ + n y₁)/(m+n) )
formulas.when: A point dividing a segment in ratio m : n. Midpoint is the m = n = 1 case.

formulas.name: The three ratios
formulas.expr: sin θ = opp/hyp,  cos θ = adj/hyp,  tan θ = opp/adj
formulas.when: Any right triangle with an angle given. Label the sides relative to θ before anything else.

formulas.name: Pythagorean identity
formulas.when: Proving identities: convert everything to sin and cos, then use this to collapse.

formulas.name: Tangent and secant
formulas.when: When tan or cot appears squared. Faster than converting to sin and cos.

formulas.name: Heights and distances
formulas.when: Angle of elevation or depression. Draw the figure and mark the right angle before any formula.

formulas.name: Area of a sector
formulas.when: A slice of the circle given its angle. Segment = sector − the triangle.

formulas.name: Length of an arc
formulas.when: The curved edge only. Perimeter of a sector adds the two radii.

formulas.name: Cylinder
formulas.when: Pipes, tanks, cans. Read whether the question wants curved or total surface.

formulas.name: Cone
formulas.expr: CSA = πrl,   V = ⅓πr²h,   l = √(r² + h²)
formulas.when: Find the slant height l first when only r and h are given.

formulas.name: Sphere and hemisphere
formulas.expr: Sphere: SA = 4πr², V = 4/3 πr³.   Hemisphere: CSA = 2πr², TSA = 3πr², V = 2/3 πr³
formulas.when: Hemisphere TSA includes the flat face -- the 3πr², not 2πr².

formulas.name: Frustum of a cone
formulas.expr: V = ⅓πh(r₁² + r₂² + r₁r₂),   CSA = π(r₁ + r₂)l
formulas.when: A bucket or a cut cone. Two different radii is the giveaway.

formulas.name: Mean of grouped data
formulas.when: Class intervals with frequencies. Use class marks for xᵢ; a table earns method marks even if the sum slips.

formulas.name: Median of grouped data
formulas.when: The class whose cumulative frequency first passes n/2 is the median class. Find it before the formula.

formulas.name: Mode of grouped data
formulas.when: The modal class has the highest frequency f₁; f₀ and f₂ are its neighbours.

formulas.name: Probability of an event
formulas.expr: P(E) = favourable outcomes / total outcomes,   P(not E) = 1 − P(E)
formulas.when: Equally likely outcomes only. List the total first -- most lost marks here are a miscounted total.
